description: The app's Session mode: the session kinds and how long they record. Read by session_reference.py; AlgorithmsConfigTest fails if Session.kt differs. Every rule about what a session may report comes from algorithms/config.json: the HRV and breathing rules from its hrv and breathing blocks, the breathing window step from bidmc.step_s, and the session-level rules (minimum intervals for heart rate, minimum breathing windows and their allowed spread) from a 'session' block that the algorithms workstream has not written yet. Until it does, session_reference.PROVISIONAL applies and the app labels those rules provisional.

extended.note: DFA alpha1 needs 200 NN intervals in unbroken runs and sample entropy 180 s of valid NN time (algorithms/config.json); a 3-minute session can hold neither, so they are reported only here.

tail_note: After the last recorded sample the detector runs on for tail_s so that beats inside the session but located late are kept: a search-back beat can be located up to 1.66 RR after it, and HIST_S (4 s) is the furthest the detector looks back. Only beats whose position lies inside the session are used, and only samples inside it.
